description: This file defines an abstract class 'TemporalExpression' used for representing and evaluating temporal expressions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for comparison, range calculation, and date inclusion checks, serving as a base for concrete temporal expression implementations.

classes.name: TemporalExpression
classes.description: An abstract class representing a temporal expression with methods for evaluation, comparison, and range calculation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to handle visitor pattern for temporal expressions.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this expression with another based on sequence.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on id and sequence.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on id and sequence.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number used for sorting.

methods.name: setSequence
methods.description: Sets the sequence number used for sorting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the expression.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the expression.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Abstract method to get the first occurrence on or after a given date.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a date is included in the expression.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the expression could produce a given date.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next occurrence after a given date, using default context.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Abstract method to get the next occurrence with context.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns a set of dates within a range that match the expression.
